integrity: All quantitative claims derive from a mathematical proof; embedded exact-rational checker is finite supporting evidence, not an infinite or independent certificate. The analysis has not undergone independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the symmetric initial opinion profile (0,1/2,1), static 3-node path, one iid uniformly selected edge per update, strict direction-specific NDW confidence rule, 0<epsilon<=1/4 and rho=1/2. No assertions about arbitrary networks, updating rates, rewiring, or arbitrary initial conditions; the full 2017 analogous article was not accessible for literature comparison. The 2024 source narrative and 2025 revision both describe directed receptiveness; the revision explicitly prints direction-specific indicators.
title: Three exact opinion phases in a minimal mixed neighborhood-confidence network
